brief: A drone workbench station: a flat covered working top with a bin beside it for screws. Dress it for a build session: a 5 inch quad on the top, a hex driver set and a LiPo battery nearby.

requirements.evidence: cover:0,0,0;full;top on piece:0,0,0;full provides flat work surface. Additional covers at -1,0,0; 0,1,0; 0,-1,0 extend top.
bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full at 1,0,0 adjacent to covered top at 0,0,0; contains prop:heap-screws-bin inside bin floor.

requirements.requirement: Dress: 5 inch quad on the top
requirements.evidence: Prop quad-5in (281mm) was requested but configurator refused placement on covered top (PROP_NO_REST: Overlaps the bin wall) and on bench positions tested; no stable placement found within turn limit, so quad not present in build.
prop:hexdriver-set@-1435,803,-829 placed on cover:-1,0,0;full;top adjacent to work top.
prop:lipo-4s@299,803,1614 placed on cover:0,1,0;full;top adjacent to work top.

finish.summary: Built L-shaped workbench with covered flat top (0,0,0) and adjacent full-depth bin (1,0,0) holding M3 screws. Hex driver set and LiPo 4S placed on neighboring covers. 5 inch quad could not be placed – the configurator rejected the large 281mm prop overlapping the bin wall and surrounding geometry, leaving that dressing requirement unmet. check_build meshClash clear, only LOOSE_BODY warning.
